provider.name: Species Fungorum
provider.organization_type: global fungal accepted-name, synonymy, nomenclature, classification, author, reference, registration, identifier, download, and taxonomic-reference infrastructure
provider.description: Species Fungorum is a global fungal taxonomic reference closely associated with Index Fungorum. It provides accepted species names, synonyms, author citations, ranks, classification, nomenclatural status, references, registration links, record identifiers, search interfaces, global species database links, and related fungal nomenclatural services.
institutional_context: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew and historical fungal nomenclatural infrastructure
CABI and fungal taxonomic data traditions
Mycologists, fungaria, culture collections, publishers, and nomenclatural registries

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting Species Fungorum documentation, organization, accepted names, synonyms, nomenclature, classification, authors, references, typification, registration, machine interfaces, downloads, schemas, editorial workflows, data quality, licenses, citations, software, standards, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: Species Fungorum, Index Fungorum, official registration and database records, original mycological literature, nomenclatural code decisions, type repositories, specialist databases, and cited external authorities remain authoritative for fungal names, status, identifiers, references, versions, rights, and contacts.
